note: PROPOSED tuning for the creature stage's test field (docs/milestones/creature-stage-plan.md section 5). Seconds are converted to whole ticks once at load (CreatureWorldSim.TICKS_PER_SECOND); metres and kilograms as written.

weapon._note: claws, horns, spikes and tusks add to the bite; the largest four count

size._note: above ref_kg the top speed falls: 0.69x at 300 kg, 0.35x at 1.2 t

social._note: sing and dance to befriend: each song adds the singer's charm; display organs (crest, frill, lure...) add charm, capped; a bitten creature will not listen

deeds._note: adaptation points earned by doing, on top of eating; spent in the editor (Bible section 3)
